title: Quietly Comforting Middle Eastern Lamb Kebabs
description: A garlicky and comforting Middle Eastern dish featuring lamb kebabs with dark chocolate chips, grilled to perfection on a yakimono grill, nut free friendly. This recipe is perfect for a dinner gathering.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
While the kebabs are cooking, melt the dark chocolate chips in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30 second increments.
Once the kebabs are done, brush them with the melted chocolate and serve immediately.
Serve with a side of lemon wedges and your choice of sides.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
